title: Event generate.token
description: Producer: worker. Transport: Redis pub/sub channel 'events:{run_id}', message = this JSON (UTF-8). Consumer: api, which relays it unchanged as an SSE message with 'event: generate.token' and 'data: <json>' on GET /api/v1/events?run_id=…; consumer of that: web. Delivery: at-most-once, no replay — clients refetch GET /stage-runs/{id} on (re)connect. Generate stage only; one per streamed delta, index contiguous from 0. Lossy (pub/sub); the final answer is in the artifact.

text.description: Token delta as streamed by the chat model.
